description:
Conduct security review of the Prequal compliance platform architecture and establish data protection standards.

Tasks:
1. Review FastAPI + React + PostgreSQL architecture for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities
2. Define data protection requirements for PII/credential data
3. Design authentication and authorization framework (JWT + OAuth2)
4. Document security policies for subcontractor data handling

Why: The platform handles sensitive compliance and credential data. Security must be built in from the start, not bolted on later.

Done means:
- Security architecture review documented
- Data protection standards defined
- Auth framework designed and documented
- Security policies ready for implementation review

Context: Part of Sprint 0. Aligns with [D62CBA01](/MID/goals/D62CBA01) and architecture decisions from [MID-6](/MID/issues/MID-6). Complements [MID-13](/MID/issues/MID-13) (FastAPI scaffolding).
title: Sprint 0 Task: Security Review and Data Protection Framework
